highlights.title: Germany’s Far Right Tops Key State Race, but Falls Short of Power
highlights.summary: The Alternative for Germany party is projected to finish first in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt. But lacking a majority, without the help of other parties it cannot become the first far-right party to govern a state since 1945.

highlights.title: Ligue 1: Paris FC and Sinayoko beat Marseille and climb to 2nd
highlights.summary: Paris FC beat Olympique de Marseille 3–2 at the Vélodrome thanks to a hat-trick from Lassine Sinayoko. Paris FC sit second but OM remain stuck in 10th place in the table.

highlights.title: Ten killed and dozens injured in Mexico fireworks blast
highlights.summary: Ten people were killed after a fireworks display detonated during a religious festival in Mexico, injuring dozens more.

highlights.title: Anti-immigration protesters clash with police in UK after boat arrival
highlights.summary: Anti-immigration protesters clashed with police in Portsmouth after around 140 people arrived in UK aboard a small boat.

highlights.title: Armed assailant attacks Ohio Democratic candidate during campaign stop
highlights.summary: Patrick Havas, 38, arrested with weapons after injuring several at Ohio Democrat Amy Acton’s campaign stop.

highlights.title: Germany's far-right AfD hails big victory in east, but falls short of majority
highlights.summary: Alternative for Germany hails a "historic" success as preliminary results show a big margin of victory with almost 44% of the vote.
